source_set_format: sha256 two spaces leaf-relative filename LF, sorted; source-validation-001.json excluded

contract.path: Exact /private/var/run/darwin-desktop-network/session-HEX48, lowercase matching nonce; slot0=session,1/2=0001/0002+nonce[:44]; safe single basename1..64
contract.directories: Retained root-to-directory openat NOFOLLOW/NONBLOCK/CLOEXEC handles; UID0 throughout; system ancestors non-group/other-write, application base/session/instance exactly0700; every path binding rechecked
contract.file: Regular0600 UID0 nlink1;<=256KiB; named caps result.json/network-client.json16384,network-client.pid32,network-shell-return.txt512; before/after dev/ino/size/mode/owner/linkcount/mtime/ctime and pathname binding; EOF required
contract.read_budget: <=128 read-loop calls,<=4096 bytes each plus one EOF read; single close attempts, failure never promoted; no retry or promised blocking syscall deadline
contract.output: Snapshot exposes acquired directory/file dev+ino and timestamps, borrowing heap/static scratch. Outputs unchanged on failure; scratch unspecified. Compare directory identity across reads under externally established quiescence.
contract.JSON: Original ASCII integer-only parser;<=262144 bytes,4096 tokens,32 levels,4194304 parsing/comparison steps. Duplicate decoded keys rejected anywhere; unknown keys allowed. No floats/exponents/NaN/overflow/trailing/bad escapes. Signed-negative64/unsigned-positive64 limits.
contract.queries: Explicit key/index path steps; strict u64/i64/bool/null/string getters, no coercion. Strings are length-delimited decodedASCII with optional embedded NUL; caller compares length+bytes. Input/token storage remains immutable and live.
caller_obligations: Actual writer/process closure before reads; stat stability alone cannot prove closure
Fixed admitted filename/schema/semantic policy including all native startup fields
Preserve earlier failures and separately establish owned process/route/daemon/network outcomes
Heap/static workspaces and common serialization; do not reuse borrowed bytes/tokens before querying finishes
Filesystem syscall or close uncertainty remains failure; no claim all FDs closed if close itself fails

independent_JSON_oracle.oracle: Python standard JSON plus duplicate/ASCII/integer64 admission; independent of C implementation

limits: Filesystem tests use an alternate temporary tree/current UID only in RG_TEST_ONLY; production is literal root/UID0
No target/Darwin filesystem process closure or syscall timing proof
Stable inode/timestamps cannot prove no writers, defeat all write-and-restore races, or provide a permanent pathname capability
Mode/UID checks do not audit ACLs/xattrs or hostile privileged writers
Semantic schema/raw-network/process verification belongs to the parent, not parser acceptance
